statement: ROOT reports Worrell 2018 main 21--478: ambient thiol-thioester exchange, base activation and photoacid inhibition in different prepared formulations, not a regenerated same-body switch; followup 500 timed out and is held. Accardo 2018 and Reisinger 2025 first opens were 403 and remain held. No snippet import or recovery.
